title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, licence requirements and documented controls agree with Microsoft's notice and documentation. The recording command's private-preview restriction is disclosed, and the page distinguishes general Teams calling controls from controls confirmed for this mobile experience.

## October 27, 2026
### Teams

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page dedicated to the mobile Copilot feature was found.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams "Copilot" "Queues app" mobile; "Queues" "Copilot" "mobile" "policy". Read manage-queues-app and October 27 release-note excerpts; they cover the app or Windows/Mac, not a dedicated mobile Copilot page.

claims.claim: General Copilot auditing automatically logs user interactions when the organization enables auditing.
claims.quote: The system automatically logs these activities as part of Audit (Standard). If your organization enables auditing, you don't need to take extra steps to configure auditing support for Copilot and AI applications.

claims.claim: The general Copilot audit rules cover these Copilot interactions when auditing is enabled.
claims.quote: The system automatically generates audit logs when a user interacts with Copilot, Cowork, or an AI application.

claims.claim: Copilot audit logs can be searched under Audit in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Access Copilot audit logs by using the Microsoft Purview portal and selecting Audit.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot retention policies cover its prompts and responses, including this Copilot experience.
claims.quote: Retention policies for AI apps include user prompts and responses for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio

claims.claim: Data copied from these AI messages is stored in a hidden user-mailbox folder.
claims.quote: Data from generative AI messages is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of the user who runs the AI app.

claims.claim: Compliance administrators can search the hidden mailbox message data using eDiscovery.
claims.quote: This hidden folder isn't designed to be directly accessible to users or administrators, but instead, store data that compliance administrators can search with eDiscovery tools.

claims.quote: Searched: "Queues app" "Copilot" "permission"; Copilot Queues app mobile disable policy permissions pricing credits. Opened manage-queues-app and Copilot calling management; read Queues release notes. No separate Copilot-in-Queues permission found.

claims.quote: Understand a customer conversation and decide on a follow-up without reviewing the full call.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: An automatic recording template is assigned at Teams admin center > Voice > Call queue > call queue > Templates > Automatic recording template.
claims.quote:
go to Voice > Call queue.
Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for.
On the Templates tab, scroll to find the Automatic recording template section.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <Guid> -AutoRecordingTemplateId <String> assigns the automatic recording template, subject to the stated private-preview restriction.
claims.quote:
Set-CsCallQueue
    -Identity <Guid>
    [-AutoRecordingTemplateId <String>]
The AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter indicates the Auto Recording template to apply to the call queue.

claims.claim: The Set-CsCallQueue reference restricts AutoRecordingTemplateId to Voice applications private-preview customers.
claims.quote:
### -AutoRecordingTemplateId
Voice applications private preview customers only.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference warns that saving the queue through Teams admin center removes that setting.
claims.quote: Saving a call queue configuration through Teams admin center will remove this setting.

claims.claim: The automatic recording setup page's August 13, 2026 entry says automatic recording can be configured via PowerShell.
claims.quote:
August 13, 2026
Automatic Recording for Call Queue can be configured via PowerShell.

claims.claim: The automatic recording template is created under Voice > Templates and resources in Teams admin center.
claims.quote:
In the Teams admin center, go to Voice > Templates and resources.
Select Templates.
Select Automatic Recording as the template type.
Select Add to create a new Automatic Recording template.

claims.claim: The general Teams calling Copilot control is at Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Copilot.
claims.quote:
Expand Voice from the navigation pane.
Under Voice, select Calling policies.
Either select an existing policy or create a new one.
From the dropdown for the Copilot setting, select On, On with saved transcript required, or Off.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled turns off Copilot for calls covered by that calling policy.
claims.quote:
To turn off Copilot for calls, use the following command:
Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled

claims.claim: The calling policy is documented for one-to-one and group calls, on a page applying to 1:1 Teams and PSTN calls.
claims.quote:
APPLIES TO: 1:1 Teams calls Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) calls
Teams calling policies control Copilot in one-to-one and group calls.
